cropping: Existing prompt-grid localized 500-sample windows (2 s at 250 Hz); no raw recutting or accepted-recording modification.
channels: Four stored channels; fresh check of 63 development trial/REST metadata rows: map 0,1,2,3. S0-S3 follow increasing tape order per acquisition protocol; no new anatomical inspection. No cyclic reindexing.
filters: Third-order zero-phase Butterworth 0.5-12 Hz, temporal demeaning, lags 0,5,...,30, 28x28 trace-ridged covariance, 406 log-Euclidean features.
duplicates: Unique recording/stroke identities checked; no marked duplicate field in W02 archive.
overwrite_protection: Root and adjacent metadata/log absent; exclusive preflight/log creation; launcher mkdir(exist_ok=False) and exclusive child log. Preserve incomplete outputs.
experiment: Part 1: 1100 real rows (22 pipelines x 2 draws x 25 scenario/swap conditions), 5500 original anchor-label permutation controls; part 2: 14 check+redo rows; part 3: 42 correction rows. Total 1156 real rows.
preprocessing: Leave one complete wear out for feature std and population class prototypes. Training vectors centered within complete training recordings. Part 1 ignores training labels. Part 2 Hungarian check uses training labels; redoing is assumed correct. Part 3 receives true labels for simulated feedback.
startup: Four first-prefix class occurrences, draws 0/1, treated as performed first. If flagged, redo uses the other four prefix strokes correctly, excludes both anchor sets, and counts four extra actions. Not literal chronological replay.

seeds.model: No PCA or stochastic learned model in G; numerical preprocessing is deterministic at fixed environment.

null_boundary: Part 1 permutes the anchor class labels, the only label-dependent input of its label-free scale. Part 2 tests permuted anchor labels with true-label-trained check prototypes; it does not refit those prototypes under training-block permutations. Parts 2/3 stream scores have no original null controls. Original null stroke predictions are not saved.
test_access: Development NPZ only; sealed B W07/W10/W12 absent and refused. No sealed NPZ/C170 waveforms opened or hashed. Accepted plans/metadata used for timing/order.
epochs: Not applicable: no neural training or checkpoint/epoch selection; fixed source grid.
status_boundary: Launcher success is insufficient; verify G_robust.exit.json and all outputs.
